blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Defense lawyers for former President Rodrigo Duterte in the International Criminal Court (ICC) have added 63 items to their list of evidence ahead of the trial for crimes against humanity starting Nov. 30. In a disclosure dated Nov. 24, the defense, led by counsel Peter Haynes, said it turned over the 63 new items to the prosecutors and the common legal representative of victims (CLRVs). This is in addition to the 108 items the defense earlier disclosed before the pretrial hearings in February, when Duterte had Nicholas Kaufman as his lead counsel.
